localPackages.@elizaos/app-core: Native bridge registration is resolved by the local application host and platform runtime.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-agent: The Capacitor agent bridge invokes only the local native application host.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-appblocker: The app-blocker bridge invokes only local operating-system capabilities.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-browser-surface: The browser-surface bridge invokes only the local embedded browser host.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-bun-runtime: The Bun runtime bridge invokes only the local embedded runtime host.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-calendar: The calendar bridge invokes only the local operating-system calendar capability.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-camera: The camera bridge invokes only the local device camera capability.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-canvas: The canvas bridge invokes only the local application rendering host.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-contacts: The contacts bridge invokes only the local operating-system contacts capability.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-desktop: The desktop bridge invokes only the local desktop application host.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-eliza-tasks: The task bridge invokes only the local operating-system task capability.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-gateway: The gateway bridge exposes the local application transport boundary.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-llama: The Llama service invokes a local native inference library rather than an external service.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-location: The location bridge invokes only the local device location capability.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-messages: The messages bridge invokes only the local operating-system messaging capability.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-mlkit-text: The ML Kit bridge invokes only the local on-device text recognition runtime.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-mobile-agent-bridge: The mobile agent bridge invokes only the local application agent host.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-mobile-signals: The mobile signals bridge invokes only local device signal capabilities.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-network-policy: The network-policy bridge enforces policy inside the local application host.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-phone: The phone bridge invokes only the local operating-system telephony capability.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-screencapture: The screen-capture bridge invokes only the local device capture capability.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-secure-store: The secure-store bridge invokes only local platform keychain storage.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-swabble: The Swabble bridge invokes only the local application and device host.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-system: The system bridge invokes only local operating-system capabilities.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-talkmode: The talk-mode bridge invokes only local audio and application capabilities.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-websiteblocker: The website-blocker bridge invokes only local operating-system capabilities.
localPackages.@elizaos/capacitor-wifi: The Wi-Fi bridge invokes only the local operating-system network capability.
localPackages.@elizaos/coding-remote-runner: This service is the hosted coding boundary itself and launches only workspace-local processes.
localPackages.@elizaos/macosalarm: The alarm action invokes only the local macOS alarm capability.
localPackages.@elizaos/plugin-goals: Goal actions, services, and views operate on local runtime repositories.
localPackages.@elizaos/plugin-health: Health views render local runtime and device-projected state.
localPackages.@elizaos/plugin-inmemorydb: The in-memory database service owns process-local deterministic state.
localPackages.@elizaos/plugin-local-storage: Local-storage services operate on the host filesystem and content store.
localPackages.@elizaos/plugin-native-filesystem: Native filesystem services invoke only local platform filesystem capabilities.
localPackages.@elizaos/plugin-native-settings: Native settings views render local platform configuration state.
localPackages.@elizaos/plugin-pdf: PDF services operate on local content bytes and bundled rendering libraries.
localPackages.@elizaos/plugin-reminders: Reminder services invoke the local platform reminder capability and scheduler.
localPackages.@elizaos/plugin-sql: The SQL service owns the configured runtime repository boundary rather than a provider protocol.
localPackages.@elizaos/plugin-task-coordinator: Task coordination actions and views operate on local runtime task state.
localPackages.@elizaos/plugin-trajectory-logger: Trajectory views render locally recorded runtime evidence.
